question: The ratio of the speeds of two trucks is 5 : 4. The time taken by the faster truck to cover a distance of 200 km is 2 hours less than the other. Find the speed of the slower truck.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speeds = 5x and 4x

Time difference = 200/4x − 200/5x = 2

(1000 − 800)/20x = 2 → 200/20x = 2

10/x = 2 → x = 5

**∴ Slower speed = 4x = 20 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed ratio = 5 : 4, Distance = 200 km, Time difference = 2 hours

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let speeds be 5x and 4x

⇒ Time taken by faster = 200/(5x)

⇒ Time taken by slower = 200/(4x)

⇒ Difference = 200/(4x) − 200/(5x) = 2

⇒ (1000 − 800)/20x = 2

⇒ 200/20x = 2

⇒ 10/x = 2

⇒ x = 5

⇒ Slower speed = 4x = 20 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 20 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Method
